title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1585 Yanceyville Street, Greensboro, North Carolina, as the J. Howard Coble Post Office Building.
official_summary: Designates the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 1585 Yanceyville Street, Greensboro, North Carolina, as the "J. Howard Coble Post Office Building."

summary.headline: Congress named a Greensboro, North Carolina post office after former Congressman J. Howard Coble.
summary.what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service facility at 1585 Yanceyville Street in Greensboro, North Carolina, as the J. Howard Coble Post Office Building. It is an honorary designation and does not change how the post office operates, its services, or its staff.
summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on January 5, 2021.
